boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Gustavus environments with documented study, research, technology, or learning affordances.

cards.title: Folke Bernadotte Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Library and research hub, connected to the Student Union
cards.notes: Set up with print and digital research materials, instructional technology, and librarian support. Check the current semester schedule before making a long session of it.
cards.short_summary: The central campus library offers varied study spaces and research help.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the library provides study spaces, instructional technologies, research materials, and librarian assistance; it lists semester hours through 11:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Semester hours listed: 8 a.m.–11:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday; 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Friday; noon–10 p.m. Sunday. Confirm exceptions with the library.

cards.entity_name: Hillstrom Museum of Art study spaces
cards.title: Hillstrom Museum of Art study spaces
cards.subtitle: Hillstrom Museum of Art, Schaefer Fine Arts
cards.notes: Use the exhibition-integrated seating when the museum is open, especially if art observation would help a reading or writing assignment. Respect exhibition and classroom activity.
cards.short_summary: A museum setting where study spaces are part of exhibition design.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillstrom Museum of Art states that inviting study spaces are integral to its exhibition design and that courses are held in its flexible classroom.
cards.source_title: The Hillstrom Museum of Art | Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.access_notes: Use during museum access and yield to scheduled classes or exhibition activity; the cited page does not publish daily visitor hours.

cards.entity_name: Olin Hall Physics lounge and library spaces
cards.title: Olin Hall Physics lounge and library spaces
cards.subtitle: Olin Hall, Physics Department
cards.notes: For physics coursework, use the department’s lounge and library spaces with computers and equipment. Confirm access with the Physics Department before relying on specialized resources.
cards.short_summary: Departmental learning space with computing and equipment access.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus describes Olin Hall as having physics student-oriented lounge and library spaces with access to computers and equipment.
cards.access_notes: These are Physics Department student-oriented spaces; ask the department about access and equipment availability.

cards.title: Nobel Hall student lounges
cards.subtitle: Nobel Hall of Science
cards.notes: Bring a group assignment or problem set and make use of the building’s student lounges and room whiteboards. Keep lab and research rooms separate from informal study use.
cards.short_summary: Science-building lounges paired with whiteboard-equipped rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nobel Hall facilities page identifies student lounges and says all rooms, regardless of size, have whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Student lounges are listed among Nobel Hall facilities. Room availability and any lab restrictions vary by use.

cards.title: Norelius Hall study areas
cards.subtitle: Norelius Hall residence hall
cards.notes: If you live in Norelius, choose one of the hall’s two large study areas for focused work away from your room. Keep the shared spaces usable for neighbors.
cards.short_summary: Two large study areas within a first-year residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists two large study areas among Norelius Hall amenities.
cards.source_title: Residential Housing & Rates | Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.access_notes: Norelius is residential housing, listed for first-year students; access is intended for residents and their permitted guests.

cards.title: Gibbs Hall ground-level study lounge
cards.subtitle: Gibbs Hall residence hall
cards.notes: Gibbs residents can move a computer-based task to the ground-level study lounge, then use the nearby computer room only as its local rules allow.
cards.short_summary: A ground-level study lounge in the North–Gibbs–Sorensen complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists a ground-level study lounge and computer room among Gibbs Hall amenities.
cards.source_title: Residential Housing & Rates | Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.access_notes: Gibbs is residential housing for upperclass students; use is for residents and permitted guests.

cards.title: North Hall study room
cards.subtitle: North Hall residence hall
cards.notes: North residents can use the basement study room when they need a dedicated shared workspace. Plan around the lounge, kitchen, and television room that share the lower level.
cards.short_summary: A designated study room in North Hall’s basement amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists a study room among North Hall’s basement lounge, kitchen, and television-room amenities.
cards.access_notes: North Hall is residential housing primarily for sophomores and juniors; use is for residents and permitted guests.

cards.title: Sohre Hall study room
cards.subtitle: Sohre Hall residence hall
cards.notes: Sohre residents can take reading or individual work to the hall study room, then return the shared area ready for the next person. Bring materials from your room.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study room among Sohre’s residential amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists a study room, large lounge, kitchen, and smaller floor lounges as amenities in Sohre Hall.
cards.access_notes: Sohre is residential housing for sophomores, juniors, and seniors; use is for residents and permitted guests.

cards.title: Uhler Hall study room/lounge
cards.subtitle: Uhler Hall lower level
cards.notes: Use Uhler’s lower-level study room/lounge for shared coursework, with the kitchen, computer room, and television room nearby. Follow residence-hall guest and quiet-hour rules.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level study room/lounge with adjacent residential amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists a study room, computer room, television room, kitchen, laundry, and lounge in Uhler Hall’s lower level.
cards.access_notes: Uhler is residential housing primarily for upperclass students; use is for residents and permitted guests.

cards.entity_name: College View Apartments common study spaces
cards.title: College View Apartments common study spaces
cards.subtitle: College View Apartments residence community
cards.notes: College View residents can use the common lounges and study spaces for a change from apartment desks. Bring what you need, and leave shared seating clear after working.
cards.short_summary: Common study spaces and lounges in a Gustavus-owned apartment building.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus states that College View Apartments contains several common lounges and study spaces, plus a computer room.
cards.source_title: College View Apartments | Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.access_notes: College View is Gustavus-owned residential housing, primarily for seniors; use is for residents and permitted guests.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Gustavus rituals and annual campus traditions, from a painted Old Main landmark to music, science, and service gatherings.

cards.title: Leave a mark on the Rock
cards.subtitle: The Rock in front of Old Main
cards.notes: Walk by the colorful Old Main rock and read its latest message; the College documents it as a canvas for announcements and congratulations.
cards.short_summary: A perpetually repainted campus message board.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus identifies painting the Rock in front of Old Main for birthdays, events, organizations, and graduations as a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Observe current paint and campus guidance; do not assume painting access or supplies are available.

cards.entity_name: Lighting a Candle in Christ Chapel
cards.title: Pause at the chapel candelabra
cards.subtitle: Christ Chapel
cards.notes: Visit the chapel’s candelabra for a quiet moment and, when available, light a candle in keeping with the posted invitation for reflection.
cards.short_summary: A reflective candle-lighting practice in the chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes a candelabra in Christ Chapel where anyone can light a candle and spend a quiet moment.
cards.access_notes: The College says the Chapel never closes; follow posted chapel instructions for candle use.

cards.title: Listen for a Gustie Rouser
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide Gustavus tradition
cards.notes: Keep an ear out for a Random Gustie Rouser and join only if the setting and organizers invite participation; it appears on Gustavus’s traditions list.
cards.short_summary: An impromptu cheer tradition named by the College.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists Random Gustie Rousers among its campus traditions.
cards.access_notes: No specific schedule or location is published on the traditions page.

cards.title: Welcome the St. Lucia Court
cards.subtitle: Annual Gustavus Swedish-heritage observance
cards.notes: Attend the public parts of the Festival of St. Lucia to hear the Court’s caroling and see a Gustavus observance sustained for decades.
cards.short_summary: A long-running St. Lucia celebration with a student court.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus states that its annual Festival of St. Lucia was 75 years strong in 2016 and that six sophomore women served on the Lucia Court.
cards.access_notes: The published account describes early-morning dorm caroling and a campus luncheon; confirm current event details before attending.

cards.title: Test the Echo Circle
cards.subtitle: Eckman Mall
cards.notes: Find the Echo Circle on Eckman Mall and test its acoustics respectfully; Gustavus specifically names hearing yourself there as a campus tradition.
cards.short_summary: A campus acoustic curiosity turned shared ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists hearing yourself at the echo circle on Eckman Mall among its traditions.
cards.access_notes: Use normal daytime campus access and keep sound considerate of nearby classes and events.

cards.title: Spin BCAD before a first test
cards.subtitle: Gustavus academic superstition
cards.notes: If you encounter BCAD, ask a current student about the ritual before using it; Gustavus lists spinning it to determine a first test grade.
cards.short_summary: A named first-test-grade superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus lists spinning BCAD to determine a first test grade as a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: The College’s traditions page does not specify BCAD’s location, availability, or operating instructions.

cards.title: Take a finals-week study break
cards.subtitle: Midnight Express
cards.notes: Watch Gustavus event communications during finals for Midnight Express, a College-described study break with jazz bands and free food.
cards.short_summary: A finals study break pairing campus jazz and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus describes Midnight Express as a study break before finals featuring Gustavus jazz bands and free food.
cards.access_notes: The College page gives no current date, time, location, or attendance details; check official announcements.

cards.title: Join the Nobel Conference conversation
cards.subtitle: Annual Gustavus science-and-society conference
cards.notes: Follow the annual Nobel Conference program and choose a session on its current theme; the College frames it as a longstanding campus signature event.
cards.short_summary: An official-Nobel-Foundation-authorized annual conference.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus says the Nobel Conference was founded in 1965 and was the first formal lecture program officially authorized by the Nobel Foundation.
cards.access_notes: Conference dates, registration, venues, and admission terms vary by year; consult the current official program.

cards.title: Experience Christmas in Christ Chapel
cards.subtitle: Christ Chapel annual Nativity celebration
cards.notes: Watch for the annual December services or the official livestream; the production brings Gustavus performers together through music, movement, and sacred story.
cards.short_summary: A multi-ensemble Christmas service more than 50 years old.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus calls Christmas in Christ Chapel a beloved annual Nativity celebration and a tradition of more than 50 years.
cards.access_notes: The official page states the Saturday evening service is livestreamed and archived on YouTube at no cost; confirm in-person ticket details.

cards.title: Cheer alongside Gus
cards.subtitle: Gustavus home athletic events
cards.notes: Attend a Gustavus home game and join the appropriate cheers from the stands; the College identifies Gus the lion as a regular cheer leader.
cards.short_summary: School-spirit cheering led by Gustavus’s plush lion mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus describes cheering for the home team, including Gus leading cheers at games, meets, and matches, as a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Game schedules, venue rules, and ticket requirements depend on the sport and event.
